corrections.text: The article states: "The GitHub release notes list the file backend's removal under deprecations as a step toward full removal in a future v2.8.0." In the actual v2.7.0 release notes, the file storage backend's removal from the main server is listed under CHANGES ("command/server: Remove file storage backend support"), not DEPRECATIONS. The DEPRECATIONS section instead lists a narrower, separate item: file-backend support specifically within the `bao operator migrate` tool is deprecated and will be removed in v2.8.0. The backend itself was already removed from the main server in v2.7.0, not scheduled for removal in v2.8.0.
